remarks: Welcome to the Farrah, a beautifully designed 1,504 sq. ft. home in the sought-after community of Kinglet by Big Lake. Offering 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, this thoughtfully crafted home combines modern style with everyday functionality. The spacious main floor features an open-concept layout, complete with a stunning kitchen highlighted by a large central island, seamlessly connecting to the dining area and inviting great room with a cozy fireplace. A generous pantry and practical mudroom provide ample storage and convenience. Designed with future flexibility in mind, the home also includes a separate side entrance and 9-foot basement ceilings, creating excellent potential for potential future development. Upstairs, you'll find three well-appointed bedrooms, a convenient laundry room, and a luxurious primary retreat featuring a walk-in closet and dual-sink vanity. Every detail has been carefully considered to maximize comfort and livability. (id:67522)
